key_entities: structured sections: Context, Problem, Scope, Approach, AC, Testing
propositions: Current clarity_score duplicated in gates.py and det_floor.py rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author-guide section contracts, allowing padded tickets to pass without Approach or grounded Scope.

Deterministic verification coverage can be extracted from AC checkbox items by detecting operator-attested markers or explicit proving clauses (verified by, verify with, checked by) paired with commands or artifacts.
Placeholder-free Scope/Approach detection should flag guide-lexicon terms (TBD, figure out, verify whether, check if, depends on investigation, choose) as deferred decisions that penalize clarity.

Required-section shape must key on graph altitude (leaf vs. container) rather than ticket type, requiring Context/Problem and AC for all plans, plus Approach+Scope for leaves and child decomposition for containers.

Per-AC text hygiene checks should flag bundled outcomes, subjective terms (works correctly), and unproved hedges (should, probably, seems) at the AC-item level, not via whole-plan vague-word scanning.

Author-guide conflict exists: current guides request Success Criteria for containers but active epic collapses it into Acceptance Criteria; clarity should not encode Success Criteria until upstream bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 is resolved.
